extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel or other significant contributors, following the required section headings, content elements, and a five-page limit for each person. The biosketch should include education/training, a personal statement, positions and honors, contributions to science with representative publications, and research support (ongoing and completed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow this format; page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each individual's biographical sketch must follow the given section headings and overall formatting; limit each person's biosketch to five pages total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; POSITION TITLE; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these identifying header items at the top of each biosketch so reviewers can readily identify the person and their eRA Commons account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a table/list with Institution and location, Degree (if applicable), Completion Date (MM/YYYY), and Field of Study. Start with the baccalaureate and include subsequent training (residency, postdoc) as relevant; add or remove rows to fit the trainee's record.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement summarizing the individual's relevant background, expertise, and suitability to contribute to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 1–2 short paragraphs to describe the applicant's expertise, mentorship record, relevant collaborations, and how the individual's experience supports their role on the project. Include a short list of the most relevant publications (“of interest for this application, including recent studies performed with [applicant]”) as examples that demonstrate the candidate's qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: List Positions and Employment and Other Experience and Professional Memberships; list Honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide chronological positions with dates and institutional affiliations, any teaching roles, other relevant experience, professional memberships, and notable honors (optionally indicating timeframe such as 'last 5 years').

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative descriptions of scientific contributions, organized as numbered items each describing a distinct contribution to science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution include a brief descriptive paragraph explaining the importance and impact of the work and then list representative publications (lettered a–e) with full citations (PMID/PMCID where available). This section shows the candidate's scientific accomplishments and gives concrete examples of representative work. A link to the complete bibliography (MyBibliography) may be provided for the full publication list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work (MyBibliography link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography (URL).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a URL linking to the candidate's full MyBibliography so reviewers can access the complete publication record beyond the representative citations in Contributions to Science.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: List Ongoing Research Support and Completed Research Support with grant numbers, sponsor, project title, dates, role, and PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing and completed support. For each item provide the grant/contract number (e.g., U01-AI069923-12), funding agency (e.g., NIAID/NIH), project title/brief description, project dates, the individual's Role (e.g., PI, Co-investigator, Key Personnel, GR), and the Project PI. Include a one-sentence description of the project's aims or relevance where useful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role and responsibility designation in research support entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the individual's Role on each listed award (e.g., PI, Co-investigator, Key Personnel (KP), Graduate (GR)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly label the person's role on each grant to clarify responsibility and level of involvement; include project PI for context.
